title: The Heart Is a Lonely Hunter

beats.what: Jade pitches the tunnel plan to Boyd: descend to the children's bones to break the trap; Boyd resists
Jade and Boyd discover a hidden door in the Colony House basement exactly where Jade described from his trip
Victor on the rooftop; Boyd learns Victor saw the man in yellow eat Miranda
Tabitha explains the doll-nightmare mechanics: fears of the dead become creatures of the forest
Donna collapses mid-sentence with a cardiac arrest; Boyd refuses to stop resuscitation attempts
Donna's pulse returns after Boyd shouts commands at her to survive; she does not regain consciousness

character_beats.beat: Wants hard evidence before committing people to a lethal tunnel mission; the hidden door provides it, but he is simultaneously carrying news of Donna's collapse and his own health decline
Explains her golem project to Ellis as an act of theological hope rather than breakdown; wants him to understand the difference between belief and delusion
Wants to hold the community together through sheer force of will; her body overrides that will in the episode's most structurally abrupt beat

key_lines.line: There is only so long that you can hold this place together with grit and good intentions.
key_lines.why: Jade names Boyd's leadership strategy as finite; the episode then makes it literal with Donna's collapse

key_lines.line: You don't die until I say you die. You hear me?
key_lines.why: Boyd's refusal of Donna's death is the episode's emotional center; it also exposes the magical thinking he otherwise suppresses

key_lines.line: I need to believe in magical things.
key_lines.why: Fatima states the episode's thesis: faith as survival mechanism, not delusion

open_loops: Donna is unconscious with unknown brain-oxygen deprivation; her recovery is uncertain
The man in yellow ate Miranda; Victor has been carrying this alone since childhood
The hidden door in the Colony House basement is now confirmed; it is sealed with a talisman
The fear-to-creature mechanism means every future death risks generating a new threat

contradiction.wants: To proceed only when he has enough evidence and a survivable plan
contradiction.does: Once the door is confirmed, he is instantly re-engaged in pushing the tunnel plan forward, abandoning the caution he demanded of Jade moments before

tone_notes: The episode's 118.9-second silence at 06:57-08:56 is the longest single gap across the seven episodes, landing in the space after Jade and Boyd discover the hidden door. The weight of confirmed evidence goes unspoken for nearly two full minutes. Overall density at 89.3 words/min is the highest in the back half of the season. The minute-30 spike (215 words/min, the episode's highest) corresponds precisely to the frantic Donna resuscitation sequence.
